name: Glider
summary: Engine-less sailplane with very long thin wings, bubble canopy and T-tail, seen from the side; anim fly floats it.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the main wheel stands on y (raise it for a glider in the sky)

params.name: s
params.note: about 960 px wide and 420 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = floats up and down and tilts gently; bob = a gentle lift; pop = scales in

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the glider faces left

author: krakujs
